newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP shares firm after half year data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP shares firm after half year data.

text.p: The shares of steel, minerals and petroleum group, The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd (BHP) firmed slightly after the company announced a weaker net profit for the six months to November 30.
At 11.45 a.m. (0045 GMT), BHP shares were 50 cents higher at A$17.55, compared with A$17.45 just before the result was announced by the Australian Stock Exchange at 0032 GMT.
BHP reported a 9.8 percent fall in its first half earnings to A$790 million from A$876 million in the previous corresponding half.
The result was made on 10.5 percent greater sales of A$10.16 billion and included an abnormal gain of A$107 million.
